scores.tell: Mid-bright key and white face separate well from the green stripes. The orange rim is a bit uniformly bright, and the stripe contrast is slightly low.
Hat is nearly the same value as the cyan rays, so it is separated by hue more than value. The vignette is mild and the crown has soft low-contrast shading.
The navy anchor is much darker than the busy orange stripe background, so the darkest mass is large and heavy. The rope highlights are strong and the stripe contrast is high and noisy.
Value groups are clean: dark navy hands on a white face, with a mid-green background. The bottom shadow is slightly dark.
Glass sits on a dark purple background, so the key is a little low. The orange liquid glows nicely, but the diamond pattern is faint and the bottom of the card is darker.
Painterly seahorse with a blue gradient and a dark vignette in the lower right. Soft local contrast and a hero that reads by hue and value. None otherwise.
Dark sand shadow and the wavy orange backdrop give a fairly busy mid-tone field. The ball's white panels are bright and the hero is close in value to the orange.
Large orange locker against purple gives a good value split. Dark interior and books add heavy accents in the middle, but the overall key stays real-looking.
Same clock composition as c127 with a darker ground shadow band at the bottom. Good separation; the stripes are only slightly high-contrast.

The saturated deep-blue anchor is the darkest, largest accent against the bright yellow-orange diagonals, giving hard contrast. Glossy specular highlights and busy diagonal stripes make it harder than the real cards.
